name: Content Studio
description: Turn an article draft into publishable content: convert Markdown to styled HTML, illustrate the body text, design a cover, and lay out infographics, with image generation available through the Nano Banana connector.
description_zh: 把一篇稿子做成能直接发布的成品：Markdown 转排版好的 HTML，配正文插图、封面和信息图，需要出图时通过 Nano Banana 连接器生成。
